data.name: Marne
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Marne was a nymph who was cursed to live in a bitter sea. Her name comes from the Greek word 'marne', meaning 'bitterness'.

Ultimately, the name "Marne" calls us to trust in God's providence and to surrender to His will, even in the midst of trials and hardships.
